sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Easiest Way)

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “FancyPost”
  4. Click “Install Now”
  5. Click “Activate”

Manual Installation

Uploading in WordPress Dashboard

  1. Download fancypost.zip
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Click “Upload Plugin”
  4. Select fancypost.zip from your computer
  5. Click “Install Now”
  6. Click “Activate Plugin”

Using FTP

  1. Download fancypost.zip
  2. Extract the folder
  3. Upload the post-block folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  4. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu

After Installation

  1. Go to Posts > Add New
  2. Click the “+” button to add a new block
  3. Search for “FancyPost” or “Post Block”
  4. Select the desired block
  5. Configure your settings
  6. Publish!

For Elementor:
1. Edit any page with Elementor
2. Search for “FancyPost” in the widget panel
3. Drag and drop the widget
4. Customize settings
5. Update!
sections.faq:
Is FancyPost free?

Yes! FancyPost offers a free version with essential features. A Pro version with advanced features is also available.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes! FancyPost is designed to work with any well-coded WordPress theme.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes! FancyPost includes Elementor widgets for easy integration.

Does it work with the Block Editor?

Absolutely! FancyPost is fully compatible with the WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg).

Can I customize the design?

Yes! FancyPost provides extensive customization options including colors, typography, spacing, and more.

Is it mobile responsive?

Yes! All layouts are fully responsive and mobile-friendly.

Does it slow down my site?

No! FancyPost is performance-optimized with clean code and minimal resource usage.

Can I use it for WooCommerce products?

Yes! The Pro version includes WooCommerce product blocks.

How do I get support?

You can get support through our Support Forum.

Is there documentation available?

Yes! Check out our detailed Documentation.

Can I translate FancyPost?

Yes! FancyPost is translation-ready and compatible with popular translation plugins.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Visit our website to purchase the Pro version.
sections.changelog:
6.0.4

  • Security: Added proper output escaping throughout the plugin
  • Security: Replaced json_encode with wp_json_encode
  • Security: Replaced _e() with esc_html_e() for proper escaping
  • Update: Localized all CDN resources (Font Awesome, CodeMirror, Leaflet, WebFontLoader)
  • Update: Fixed all text domain issues for proper localization
  • Update: Added direct file access protection to template files
  • Update: Removed update checker manipulation code
  • Update: Tested with WordPress 6.9
  • Fix: Fixed file naming issues

6.0.2

  • Update: Plugin name updated to comply with WordPress.org guidelines
  • Update: Removed promotional language from readme
  • Update: Tested with WordPress 6.7
  • Fix: Minor bug fixes and improvements

6.0.1

  • Fix: Compatibility improvements
  • Update: Performance optimization

6.0.0

  • Major: Complete rebuild
  • Add: New block variations
  • Update: Improved UI/UX
  • Fix: Various bug fixes

5.9.0

  • Add: New layout options
  • Update: Enhanced customization
  • Fix: Mobile responsiveness
